title: Routes of administration
binding: a questionnaire question's `answer_value_set`, when the answer carries the concept
source: Members of the FHIR R4 published value set http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/route-codes, each confirmed to be in it through tx.fhir.org. A subset and not the whole list, because that list runs to several hundred routes including intrathecal and suprachoroidal ones, and a picker offering those at a health centre is a picker nobody can use. Choosing which routes a health centre administers by is a product decision rather than a clinical claim: no route here says anything about a drug, a dose or an indication.
